name: contract-authored-proof-inputs
goal: Freeze authored expectation semantics and admit test-only contract edits without changing historical evidence

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Canonical Examples introduced by this task moved executable expectations into specification/units. The prior regression freezer covers tests, fixtures and runner configuration but omits those manifests, so a fix can change source and its authored answer together. Test-only admission also rejects legitimate authored contract edits.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing bug-fix/fix/regression-prevention CLI cases verify only changed proof.ts bytes. Migrate their owning command function to canonical Examples, retain every CLI and history assertion, then strengthen those same repair cases with an authored-answer mutation that would otherwise accept wrong source. Keep that case matrix unchanged during repair.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 14e3b2d987 the same 31 cases fail in retained record 64699ce13059. The authored-answer case observes a resolved promise where case identity and example mutations must reject; the other failures expose absent semantic hashes, disguised product metadata/source and authored-only admission. The proof scope names only regression-files; command.loop automated execution remains pending on the laptop.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Freeze real Git file blobs and separate typed authored expectation digests. Hash complete raw authored JSON, including identity, state, calls, inputs and expected values; keep source blob provenance. Admit unit edits only when product fields are identical and named cases are strengthened. New proof requires the current metadata protocol; historical records remain unchanged. Preserve all 23 helper, ten command and eight guidance cases.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Commit bfc281f4b3 freezes authored contract digests separately from original Git blobs and rejects product edits disguised as named tests. The unchanged 23 helper, ten CLI and eight guidance cases pass on harbor-mbp-2; compiler, lint and audit pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired proof on harbor-mbp-2: red c8ee87789f1a at edb6f08c6f has seven product-caused failures and 24 passes; green 847e8c5e44cc at bfc281f4b3 passes the same 31 cases. Command, environment, executable corpus and 72 authored expectation digests remain fixed.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The unchanged authored-answer case creates real disposable Git revisions with altered case identity, generic Examples and wrong source plus a changed answer; each repair is rejected. Test-only admission cases reject disguised source and metadata while accepting authored-only edits. The isolated broken-source red and repaired green snapshots retain actual failures and passes.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
